Page.Name: page.custom.omnibar
Page.Title: Omni bar
Page.Subtitle: One field that finds every page and runs commands (themes, sidebar, history, notifications). Type a few letters: every word must match; titles that start with them come first. Up / Down move, Enter or a click runs, Escape clears. src/omnibar.c; the same code drives the command palette laid over the window with Cmd+K.

Demo.Title: Command palette
Demo.Note: Over everything, with a dimmed background; a click outside closes it.
